جَاءَ — السَّمَاءِ — سُوءَ — جِيءَ
تحفة الأطفال

articles.x: That a letter of madd comes at the end of a word while the hamzah comes at the beginning of the following word; its ruling is permissibility, and according to Hafs via…

b.v: That a letter of madd comes at the end of a word while the hamzah comes at the beginning of the following word; its ruling is permissibility, and according to Hafs via the route of ash-Shatibiyyah it is prolonged for four or five harakahs.
يَا أَيُّهَا — إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ — بِمَا أُنزِلَ
تحفة الأطفال

articles.x: That an incidental sukun follows a letter of madd due to pausing at the end of the word; its ruling is permissibility, and shortening, medium length, or full length are…

b.v: That an incidental sukun follows a letter of madd due to pausing at the end of the word; its ruling is permissibility, and shortening, medium length, or full length are all permitted, though it is preferable to adhere to a single way consistently.
الْعَالَمِينَ — الرَّحِيمِ — نَسْتَعِينُ
تحفة الأطفال

articles.x: That the hamzah precedes a letter of madd within a single word; its origin is two hamzahs, the second of which was replaced with a letter of madd.

b.v: That the hamzah precedes a letter of madd within a single word; its origin is two hamzahs, the second of which was replaced with a letter of madd. Its ruling is permissibility, and according to Hafs it is prolonged for the duration of two harakahs.
آمَنُوا — إِيمَانًا — أُوتُوا — آدَمَ
تحفة الأطفال

articles.x: That an original sukun, fixed both when continuing (wasl) and when pausing (waqf), follows a letter of madd; its ruling is obligatory necessity (luzum), and it must be…

b.v: That an original sukun, fixed both when continuing (wasl) and when pausing (waqf), follows a letter of madd; its ruling is obligatory necessity (luzum), and it must be prolonged for six harakahs. It is divided into word-based (kalimi) and letter-based (harfi).
الضَّالِّينَ — الْحَاقَّةُ — الم — ص — ن
تحفة الأطفال

articles.x: The vibration/bouncing of the letter when it is pronounced sakin (with sukun) so that a strong echoing sound is heard from it.

b.v: The vibration/bouncing of the letter when it is pronounced sakin (with sukun) so that a strong echoing sound is heard from it. Its letters are five, found in «قُطْبُ جَدٍّ» (qaf, ta, ba, jim, dal). It is minor (sughra) in the middle of a word, and major (kubra) when pausing.
يَجْعَلُونَ — الْفَلَقِ — أَحَدٌ
تحفة الأطفال

articles.t: Rules of the Letter Ra (Heavy and Light Pronunciation)
articles.x: The ra is pronounced heavy (mufakhkham) when it has fathah or dammah, or when it is sakin following a fathah or dammah.

b.v: The ra is pronounced heavy (mufakhkham) when it has fathah or dammah, or when it is sakin following a fathah or dammah. It is pronounced light (muraqqaq) when it has kasrah, or when it is sakin following an original kasrah that is not followed by a letter of isti'la (elevation).
تفخيم: رَبِّ، الْقُرْآنَ — ترقيق: رِجَالٌ، فِرْعَوْنَ
تحفة الأطفال

articles.t: Rules of the Lam in the Name of Allah
articles.x: The lam of the Name of Allah («الله») is pronounced heavy (mufakhkham) when preceded by a fathah or dammah, and light (muraqqaq) when preceded by a kasrah.

b.v: The lam of the Name of Allah («الله») is pronounced heavy (mufakhkham) when preceded by a fathah or dammah, and light (muraqqaq) when preceded by a kasrah. This rule is specific to the lam of the Name of Allah alone, not any other lam.
تفخيم: قَالَ اللَّهُ، عَبْدُ اللَّهِ — ترقيق: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
تحفة الأطفال

articles.t: Tafkhim and Tarqiq (Heavy and Light Pronunciation)
articles.x: Tafkhim (heaviness) is a fullness that enters the letter, so that the mouth is filled with its resonance, while tarqiq (lightness) is a leanness in which the mouth is…

b.v: Tafkhim (heaviness) is a fullness that enters the letter, so that the mouth is filled with its resonance, while tarqiq (lightness) is a leanness in which the mouth is not filled by it. The seven letters of isti'la (elevation), found in «خُصَّ ضَغْطٍ قِظْ», are always pronounced heavy.
تفخيم: الطَّامَّةُ، خَلَقَ، الصِّرَاطَ — ترقيق: الْحَمْدُ
تحفة الأطفال والجزرية
